SELECT
    c.Occupation                                                                        AS customer_segment,
    count(DISTINCT f.CustomerKey)                                                       AS num_customers,
    sum(f.SalesAmount)                                                                  AS total_sales,
    sum(f.TotalCost)                                                                    AS total_cost,
    sum(f.SalesAmount) - sum(f.TotalCost)                                               AS gross_margin,
    round(
        (sum(f.SalesAmount) - sum(f.TotalCost)) * 100.0
        / nullif(sum(f.SalesAmount), 0),
        2
    )                                                                                   AS gross_margin_pct
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimCustomer c ON f.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
WHERE c.Occupation IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.Occupation
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
